headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 18, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox continued their dominance over the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 5-3 victory in their latest matchup. Wilyer Abreu led the charge at the plate with two home runs and three RBIs. Aroldis Chapman earned the save for the Red Sox.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with Lourdes Gurriel Jr. being placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right adductor strain for the Arizona Diamondbacks. Other notable injuries include Jeff Criswell's right shoulder strain for the Colorado Rockies, Sal Frelick's right shoulder strain for the Milwaukee Brewers, and Chris Bassitt's low back discomfort for the Baltimore Orioles.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Kansas City Royals trading Rudy Martin Jr. to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The Washington Nationals traded Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash, while the Houston Astros traded Lance McCullers Jr., Colton Gordon, and cash to the Milwaukee Brewers for outfielder Jadyn Fielder.

top_news.title: **Rays Suffer Shutout Loss to Red Sox**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 10-0, handing them a decisive defeat. Carlos Narváez led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Jake Bennett earned the win with 6 strong innings of work.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Rally Past Rays 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 5-3 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Wilyer Abreu leading the charge at the plate. Abreu hit two home runs and drove in three runs, while Aroldis Chapman earned the save with a scoreless inning of relief.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Yankees in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the New York Yankees 2-1, with Max Muncy leading the charge at the plate. Muncy's 18th home run of the season, a fly ball to right field, scored Mookie Betts and proved to be the game-winner.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Rangers in Blowout Victory**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Texas Rangers 15-1, securing a decisive win. Chris Sale led the Braves' pitching effort, throwing 7.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Bryan Reynolds and Brandon Lowe leading the charge on offense. Jared Jones and Gavin Williams stood out on the mound for the Pirates.

top_news.title: **Gurriel Jr. Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks left fielder Lourdes Gurriel Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right adductor strain.

top_news.title: **Orioles Acquire Rudy Martin Jr. in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles have acquired right fielder Rudy Martin Jr. in a trade with the Kansas City Royals, who received cash in return.
